gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Commanding from the first letter, Wallpoet runs smooth around every bend. Wallpoet works big and short, paper showing between its letters; Noto Sans Ethiopic follows with sturdy lowercase and c terminals hanging far from the bowl.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Noto Sans Georgian is clean and modern, with open curves throughout and short ascender stems on its lowercase. Wallpoet is best at commanding attention, the Georgian at being easy to follow.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Wallpoet is loud and gapped up top, then Noto Sans Grantha brings high little letters like flattened pen-nib bowls. Reading it should glide, with no closed-up bowl to snag on.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-hk: Noto Sans HK reads clean, with large lowercase forms and brush ends lifting away before each curve closes. Wallpoet shouts the headline, and this sans should carry paragraph after paragraph without strain.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-jp: Commanding, Wallpoet sweeps smoothly around each bend with lowercase that rises high. Noto Sans JP works beneath it, curves sweeping open and its x-height very high, a modern counterpart to the display shapes.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Noto Sans Khmer is clean, modern and generously open. Wallpoet brings the bold, gapped lettering, and the real strength is how this sans keeps its small letters standing almost capital-sized beside it.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Noto Sans Lepcha reads approachable, its curves keeping a wide opening. What stands out is the gap between Wallpoet, commanding and smooth-curved, and a lowercase with the stature of cast iron capitals.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Noto Sans Limbu reads contemporary and approachable, its curves gaping open and its small letters built with generous height. Yet Wallpoet brings the commanding punch, so this sans feels all the more relaxed.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Noto Sans Mahajani is modern, its lowercase rising above the capitals. Wallpoet takes the top line with smooth curves and gaps, and this body follows with a funnel-wide e that keeps paragraphs open.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numer: Wallpoet opens the page with bold, commanding letters and a line where the paper shows through between them. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals settles in below, its c visibly gaping.
